title: padus avium var. aucubifolia
intro: Padus avium var. aucubifolia, commonly known as Bird Cherry or May Cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and it has been used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Padus avium var. aucubifolia include antiseptic, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, making it useful for treating infections, relieving muscle spasms, and promoting urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
